text:
deploy-bot: Scheduled private rollout: customer=borealis-prod, target=Dedicated:dpool-a
Window: Fri Mar 28 02:00-03:00 UTC
Pinned model: redwood-model-v2.3 (force-pin)
Canary plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% (manual gates)
Fallback: automatic rollback to redwood-model-v2.2 if >5% error rate OR p95 latency >2s sustained for 5m
Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/rel-2.3.0 (configs, known issues)
Owners: @olivia @raj @maria_pm @sre-oncall
---
olivia: ack, I'll be on call for the window. planning to watch traffic-shift and perf dashboards :thumbsup:
raj: quick Q — any DB schema or infra changes included?
deploy-bot: No DB schema migrations detected. No infra infra changes. Only model binary + quantization profile update.
andre_engineer: canary size OK. recommend start at 5-10% for first 15m, check quality eval set and tok-cost. We should keep KV cache warm before cutover.
olivia: noted. andre, can you run the cache-warm script 30m before window?
andre_engineer: will do. script: ```./ops/cache_warm.sh --customer borealis-prod --duration 20m```
maria_pm: approved from product. confirmed no feature flags to flip. I'm good with 10% canary and manual ramp after safety checks.
sre-oncall: I'll own metrics and rollback triggers. Please set alerting for these (creating now): error-rate > 3% (5m), p95 latency > 1.8s (5m), 5+ infra errors in 2m. If any fire, we'll hit rollback.
zoe_security: quick compliance note: need to ensure audit-logs retention is enabled during rollout window. I checked and customer audit backlog is at 0.5GB, within retention. Also confirm KMS rotation isn't happening this week.
raj: thanks — no migrations is good. one ops ask: pin docker image sha in deploy manifest? to avoid drift.
andre_engineer: already in manifest, using `redwood/inference:2.3.0@sha256:abcdef...`
olivia: decision on canary duration? recommend 20m initial soak, then 30m mid ramp. keep manual thumbs to proceed.
sre-oncall: 20m initial is fine. set automation: if metrics stable, we'll schedule manual approval at 20m to move to 50%.
maria_pm: adding product acceptance checklist link: https://redwood.internal/acceptance/borealis-2.3
olivia: last check: rollback playbook link?
deploy-bot: Rollback playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/rollbacks#model-rollback
raj: approved from eng infra. :thumbsup:
zoe_security: approved from security. please capture IAM access list for the deployment in the ticket.
andre_engineer: cache warm scheduled at 01:30 UTC, I'll post logs in the runbook channel.
sre-oncall: I'll create short dashboard and temporary alert channel `#incident-borealis-rollout` and invite owners.
maria_pm: product sign-off recorded.
olivia: all green from me. let's proceed unless anyone objects.
raj: no objections. go for launch. :rocket:
andre_engineer: logging note — include these extra flags in deploy command: `--warm-kv --no-batch-resize`
olivia: copy. final checklist done. good luck team.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled. To initiate run: `deployctl rollout start --customer borealis-prod --pool dpool-a --manifest manifests/borealis/2.3/rollout.yaml`
---
(react: olivia :thumbsup:, raj :thumbsup:, maria_pm :heart:, andre_engineer :eyes:, sre-oncall :rocket:)
